notes:
- Stutters and repeated words are cut far more often (\"don't even, don't even try\" plays \"don't even try\"): Revive now listens to each stutter cut before keeping it, so it never takes the wrong word.
- Ums, uhs and ahs are always cut, including ones that run straight into the next word or end a sentence, each checked by ear.
- Revive also listens to the whole clip once for ums and repeats the transcript missed.
